# AI Man Jack

> AI Man Jack LLC (aimanjack.com) is Jack Qian's Dallas, Texas company for hands-on AI training. Jack teaches non-technical teams in English or Chinese using tasks they already do: each participant builds one working AI workflow and learns how to verify its output. Formats are a 90-minute lunch-and-learn, a half-day workshop and a multi-week program, priced per engagement. Training evidence currently shown on the site: five community talks with 50+ people each, one 37-person hackathon and 10 Google reviews averaging 5.0. The company also provides an AI receptionist and booking service for appointment businesses. Book a 30-minute call at https://aimanjack.com/book/, text TRAINING to +1 (469) 425-4142, call the AI demo at +1 (469) 517-2968, or email jack@aimanjack.com. A visitor may request one unique $25 coupon per email for any AI Man Jack service; each coupon is used once and manually redeemed. There is no minimum spend, expiration or new-customer restriction.

Key facts:
- Company: AI Man Jack LLC, Dallas, Texas. Founder and operator: Jack Qian. One person handles setup, testing and support.
- Primary service: hands-on AI training for Dallas–Fort Worth teams, taught in English or Chinese. Each participant works on a real recurring task and leaves with a working workflow plus a verification checklist.
- Additional service: AI receptionist + booking for salons and beauty, med spas, clinics (dental, chiropractic, physical therapy, acupuncture), home services and repair services. Demo line: +1 (469) 517-2968, always on in English, Spanish and Chinese.
- Limits: the AI answers only from information the business approved; it does not invent answers, does not give medical or legal advice, and makes no promise about search rankings or AI-assistant recommendations. Unsupported questions go to the fallback flow (message, transfer, or text to the owner).
- Integrations (as of September 2026): AI Man Jack's own booking system = Supported; call forwarding or a new dedicated number = Supported; texting the owner = Supported; Google Calendar and customer confirmation texts = Pilot; Square, Booksy, Vagaro, Fresha, Calendly, VoIP systems and CRMs = Ask us (not yet tested).
- Setup: about one week after the business supplies hours, services, prices and booking rules, then a tuning period. Cancellation: month to month. The client keeps website files and domain; included hosting ends with the service. The client's number is theirs; a provisioned number can be transferred or ported to the client when service ends. No call recordings or transcripts are stored by AI Man Jack.
- Case studies: AI Man Jack's own demo line (pilot, numbers published after the first full month) and an SMS booking agent for a used-car dealership in DFW (live, metrics not yet published). No customer metrics are invented.
- Consultation: the site and booking service use one 30-minute call length. The phone demo and SMS contact remain available.
- Coupon: one unique $25 code per normalized email, valid once for any service and manually redeemed. Claiming it does not subscribe the email to marketing.
- Profiles: X https://x.com/JackQianAI · YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@JackBuildAI · GitHub https://github.com/qianquandong · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/quandong-qian-156563191/ · Nextdoor https://nextdoor.com/page/ai-man-jack-melissa-tx/
